posts.text: Nike yields 4.37%, 3.1x its 5-year average. Domino's Pizza yields 2.55%, 2.06x its 5-year average. Both have maintained dividends for over 10 years.
Quantic's Consumer Cyclical screener includes 61 companies. The median 5-year average yield is 2.38% and the median 5-year dividend growth is 8.9%.
$CLX hits ex-dividend today with a 5.72% yield. It is flagged as 'at risk' with 23 years of consecutive increases, despite a 2.5% 5-year growth rate.
Three utilities posted dividend raises this month: Consolidated Edison (+1.1%), American Electric Power (+2.1%), and NiSource has an ex-div date of Oct 30.
Diageo reduced its dividend by 39.8% to an annual rate of 2.00 USD, seen on Oct 17. Its 5-year dividend growth stands at 2.6%.
BAE Systems PLC raised its dividend by 5.6% to 0.38 GBP, seen on Oct 25. It has maintained the dividend for 21 consecutive years.
$MSFT increased its annual dividend rate from 3.64 to 3.92 USD, a 7.7% raise. The move brings its 5-year dividend growth to 10.2%.
In Quantic's Energy sector, 43 companies show a median 5-year yield of 4.64%. In Real Estate, 56 companies show a median 5-year yield of 4.93%.
